\textit{Note.} fwdplainc tex (plain walls over the checkerboard floor): values shown for completeness only; the heading failed Phase 3 validation on this floor (H1.2), so no heading benefit is claimed there (restatement ruling 4).\par
\textit{Note.} fwdc/fwdplainc trans, blank: all four arms are in the runaway category (position frozen once flow aiding is lost, or diverging once never gained); the metre-scale values are evidence of that category, from numbers\_ekf3\_heading.md's own per-bag table, not a precise ranking between arms.\par
\textit{Note.} OQ-R3 (both pictures of EKF3 + heading, labelled): the closed-loop panel (EKF3 flown with the camera heading in Experiment 1C, raw from take-off, labelled 'closed loop, picture only, not scored' - a different trajectory, no score printed) is candidate figure A20 (docs/thesis/figures\_thesis/candidates/), not yet in the numbered set; this table is the scored offline arm, labelled 'offline Replay, 5\textdegree{} floor'.\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
